content.short: Onmeta provides fiat onramp and offramp infrastructure for wallets and apps that want local payment access.
content.description: Onmeta offers fiat to crypto and crypto to fiat infrastructure for Web3 products that need embedded payment flows instead of sending users to a separate exchange. Its official docs describe widget and API integrations, built in KYC handling, transaction management, and support for regional payment methods such as UPI, bank transfers, and other local rails. The platform also lists TON among supported networks, so teams can use Onmeta to help users move from local currency into TON ecosystem assets through a checkout flow that is designed for partner apps and wallets.
content.meta: Onmeta gives wallets and dapps fiat onramp and offramp tools with local payment methods, KYC workflows, partner checkout, and TON support.
